pages.title: Ocean Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §rCraft it using the recipe on the next page.$(br2)§lEffect: §rActive while held: immune to the underwater mining penalty, with underwater mining speed increased to 1.25×; immune to water current slowdown and water current push; no need to breathe underwater and immune to drowning damage; guardians and elder guardians will not actively attack the holder, but will fight back normally if attacked.
